title: Nvidia rejects near-term memory glut fears, leaves CXMT cooperation open
content: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said the company did not expect memory supply to exceed demand in the coming years and remained open to working with China's ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT). The comments, made during the GTC Berlin conference and reported by CNBC, came as falling market valuations for memory manufacturers and new Chinese dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) developments intensified concerns about oversupply.

title: Bosch to spin off automotive business as Asian rivals intensify pressure
content: Bosch Group plans to establish Bosch Mobility as a wholly owned, legally independent subsidiary in August 2027, separating the business that generated about 60% of group revenue. The move will complete the restructuring of Bosch's four major business areas and leave the parent company focused on strategic oversight and centralized research and development.

title: AIDC launches Taiwan's largest industrial microgrid with 9MW/54MWh energy storage capacity
content: Aerospace Industrial Development Corporation (AIDC) held an inauguration ceremony for its 9MW/54MWh large-scale microgrid system at its Shuinan facility in Taichung on October 22, marking the official commissioning of what the company describes as Taiwan's largest industrial behind-the-meter energy storage microgrid.

title: LGES Poland plant nears breakeven as utilization rebounds
content: LG Energy Solution (LGES)'s Wroclaw plant in Poland, long viewed as a major drag on the business, is nearing profitability after posting an operating loss of nearly KRW600 billion (approximately US$430 million) in 2025. A surge in European EV demand and the early conversion of some production lines to energy storage system (ESS) applications have lifted utilization, putting the plant on track to return to profit in the fourth quarter of 2026.
